{{nihongo|'''Osada Nimasu Amateru Mitama Shrine'''|他田坐天照御魂神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Sakurai, Nara|Q127026|qid=Q127026}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is a {{ill|Shikinai Taisha|ja|式内大社|simple|Shikinai Taisha|qid=Q134917288}}, and its former {{ill|Shakaku|ja|社格|ko|사격 (신토)|zh|社格|qid=Q10444029}} was {{ill|Son-sha|ja|村社|qid=Q134917284}}. {{nihongo|'''Osada Nimasu Amateru Mitama Shrine'''|他田坐天照御魂神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

== History ==
== Outline ==
This place is said to have once been the site of Osata-no-Sakitama-no-miya, a palace of {{ill|Emperor Bidatsu|Q316637|qid=Q316637}}, and the shrine is said to mark where the {{ill|Hinomatsuri-be|Q109597716|qid=Q109597716|lt=Hinomatsuri-be}} established by Bidatsu was placed (though there is also a theory that Osata-no-Sakitama-no-miya was at {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Kasuga Shrine}} in Kaijū, Sakurai). In the {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}} it was listed as a great shrine, but afterward it disappears from historical records; in the {{ill|Edo period|Q184963|qid=Q184963}} it called itself Kasuga Shrine.

== Court rank ==
*{{ill|Ten'an|Q1075611|qid=Q1075611|lt=Ten'an}} 3 ({{ill|859|Q23897|qid=Q23897}}), {{ill|January 27|Q2284|qid=Q2284}}: promoted from Junior Fifth Lower to Junior Fifth Upper (''{{ill|Nihon Sandai Jitsuroku|Q1052981|qid=Q1052981}}'') - written as “Osada Amateru-Mitama-no-Kami”

== Enshrined deity ==
'''Amateru-Mitama-no-Mikoto'''<br />There are various theories on the deity’s identity.
* ''Jingi Hōten'': aramitama of Amaterasu Ōmikami
* ''{{ill|Jinja Kakuroku|Q11590708|qid=Q11590708}}'': Ama-no-hi-no-kami-no-Mikoto
* ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō Studies|Q11588824|qid=Q11588824}}'': Amateru-kuni-teru-hiko-hoakari-no-Mikoto / Nigihayahi-no-Mikoto, ancestor of the Shiki clan
* ''{{ill|Tokusen Jinmyōchō|ja|特選神名牒|qid=Q11571092}}'': {{ill|Amenohoakari|fr|Ame-no-hoakari|it|Amenohoakari|ja|天火明命|ko|아메노호아카리|mni|ꯑꯃꯦꯅꯣꯍꯣꯑꯀꯔꯤ|simple|Ame-no-hoakari|zh|天火明命|qid=Q10940411}}
